title: Canada's counter-tariffs take effect — 15/25/50% on ~C$27.6B of US goods
source: NEWS: canada.ca Department of Finance, 'List of products from the United States subject to counter-tariffs effective September 8, 2026' and the 2026-08-25 announcement 'Canada announces targeted countermeasures and substantive support for workers and businesses in response to U.S. tariffs' — both fetched direct 2026-09-09, the second carrying the in-force wording 'as of 12:01 a.m., September 8, 2026'. Corroborated by the Blakes insight of the same title (fetched direct 2026-09-09), Davis Wright Tremaine's Section 338 alert, and Covington's globalpolicywatch post of 2026-09-04. THE EVENT IS NOW SETTLED IN THE PAST — press of 2026-09-08 (search-summary reads of Reuters/AP carries) reports the surtax in force from 12:01 a.m. that Tuesday with no deferral, no carve-out beyond the published in-transit exemption, and no deal. STAYS ESTIMATE FOR A SCHEMA REASON, NOT DATE DOUBT — do not spend another session trying to promote it: event-scan-validation.mjs's CONFIRMED_PREFIX admits only IR|CAL|BLS|FED|PJM|SEC|TSY|OCC|BEA|CENSUS|ISM|CB and has no slot for a foreign government's own gazette or press release, the same mechanical gap boj-decision-2026-09-18 and us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10 already record
notes: CLOSED 2026-09-09 (D+1) — ledger docs/research/events/canada-counter-tariffs-effective-2026-09-08.md carries initial research and the close-out in one session, because the event reached this calendar only after it had already passed. WHAT HAPPENED: the surtax came into force at 12:01 a.m. ET 2026-09-08 on ~600+ tariff classifications covering C$27.6B of US-origin imports at 15/25/50%, rate-matched line-by-line to the US duty on the same good; goods in transit on the day are exempt; Canada's existing remission framework remains the only relief path; a C$7.5B domestic support package (C$3.5B worker/employer supports, C$2B diversification fund, C$1.5B regional initiative, C$0.5B BDC liquidity) rode alongside. Sequence: proclamations 11046/11047/11048 of 2026-07-20 invoked Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 (19 U.S.C. 1338) — never used since 1930 — for 50% on ~$20B of Canadian goods across 554 HTS lines; proclamation 11056 of 2026-08-18 slipped the start from 08-19 to 08-22; talks collapsed 08-21 and the duty took effect 12:01 a.m. 08-22; Carney announced the dollar-for-dollar match 08-25. THE MEASURED CHANNEL TO THIS BOOK IS NIL: S&P 500 7674.37 (08-21) -> 7673.52 (09-08) = -0.01% across the entire escalation, VIX 15.72 on the effective day, and the two worst performers in the exposed basket (IP -12.1%, TSN -10.6% over the same window) both fell on named non-tariff drivers (IP's Q2 print/containerboard de-rating; Tyson's 09-03 beef guidance cut). US steel ROSE (CLF +9.1%, NUE +5.2%, STLD +5.1%) — the US wall protects their domestic book and Canada's surtax hits only their small export leg, so the sign of a tariff exchange for a protected domestic producer is positive, not negative. TIER CARRIED, NOT MEASURED: `medium` is the proposer's call on the ~US$47.6B combined footprint and an unresolved, undated escalation, NOT on a measured market channel — 12 sessions is too thin a base to re-tier on. THE FRAMING CORRECTION worth carrying: Canada's counter-tariffs are a CANADIAN price event, not a US CPI event — they tax US goods entering Canada. The US-side goods-inflation leg is the Section 338 duty of 08-22 (alcohol, dairy, maple syrup, plywood, hockey equipment), which this calendar does not track and which is legally untested — Section 338 is the post-Learning-Resources workaround for the IEEPA authority the Supreme Court voided on 2026-02-20, and as of 2026-08-29 press no suit had been filed. NO DATED FORWARD HOOK EXISTS on either side: no review, sunset or scheduled negotiation in either instrument, and Carney's 'when the Americans are ready' (2026-09-03) is undated. The one dated successor found is the USMCA/CUSMA annual joint review the US triggered by declining to extend on 2026-07-01 — proposed in the same PR as proposals/usmca-joint-review-2027-07-01.from-canada-counter-tariffs-effective-2026-09-08.json. Originally discovered during the jobs-2026-10-02 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-09); that proposal is shadowed by this file.
